Answers recorded from the SummitFlow hook.

cases.command: A checkout copy whose backend/.venv is empty, as on 2026-10-09.

The PreToolUse publication hook must survive a broken backend/.venv.

Regression: on 2026-10-09 backend/.venv was emptied and the hook, which ran
under that venv, denied every agent shell for about four hours.

The live PreToolUse hook denies a small irreversible command set.

Regression: the destructive guard in command_guard had no live caller, so the
shared hook let ``git reset --hard``/``git clean -fd``/``rm -rf <project>``
through in checkouts shared by many agents.
